# Alexis Davidson brand 2.1.0

> The shared design system for Alexis Davidson's apps: tokens, components, light/dark theme and jewel-tone accents.
> Garnet is the brand color. Load theme.js then brand.css from https://tools.alexisdavidson.org/brand/v2/.

- [Rules for agents](https://tools.alexisdavidson.org/brand/v2/AGENTS.md): hard rules, states, scales
- [Tokens](https://tools.alexisdavidson.org/brand/v2/tokens.json): every token, both themes, with descriptions
- [Components](https://tools.alexisdavidson.org/brand/v2/components.json): classes, variants, ARIA, keyboard, snippets
- [Style guide](https://tools.alexisdavidson.org/brand/): live previews
